The corporation's listed chief executive is Julian C. Cabrera, matching the agenda title 'Julian Cabrera dba Julian Tree Care, Inc.'

research.notes: Registry details come from a third-party mirror of California Secretary of State filings (bizprofile.net), not the Secretary of State site itself. The company website shows a Richmond address in its page data but a Mill Valley address in its footer, and two different general email addresses, so email was left null. Agenda text variously names the vendor as 'Julian Tree Care Inc.' and 'Julian Cabrera dba Julian Tree Care, Inc.'; this is a corporation, not an individual contractor.

profile.summary: Julian Tree Care is a family-run, licensed tree service company serving the San Francisco Bay Area. It offers tree trimming and pruning, tree removal, stump grinding, wood chipping, yard clearing and 24-hour emergency tree services.
